mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the kidney filters was most worthwhile because the result showed that useful glucose enters the filtered fluid along with urea, explaining why recovery matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting passages and then the ureters was clear but predictable; those steps added less to my understanding than filtration and recovery.

surprise.text: The filter let glucose and water through along with urea while retaining red blood cells and large proteins. That changed my understanding of filtration as the beginning of a selective process rather than simply removing waste.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each part had a visible role in the route, although the sequence offered few decisions that required much thought.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it connected the systems in a new way. This chapter's explanations were clear, but its combinations were mostly predictable.
